FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.a1: Netflix is a streaming service that offers a wide variety of award-winning TV shows, movies, anime, documentaries, and more on thousands of internet-connected devices.
FAQ.a2: Watch Netflix on your smartphone, tablet, Smart TV, laptop, or streaming device, all for one fixed monthly fee.
FAQ.a3: Watch anywhere, anytime. Sign in with your Netflix account to watch instantly on the web at netflix.com from your personal computer or on any internet-connected device.
FAQ.a4: Netflix is flexible. There are no pesky contracts and no commitments. You can easily cancel your account online in two clicks. There are no cancellation fees.
FAQ.q5: What can I watch on Netflix?
FAQ.a5: Netflix has an extensive library of feature films, documentaries, TV shows, anime, award-winning Netflix originals, and more. Watch as much as you want, anytime you want.
FAQ.a6: The Netflix Kids experience is included in your membership to give parents control while kids enjoy family-friendly TV shows and movies in their own space.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.membershipContent: Your Netflix membership will continue until terminated. To use the Netflix service you must have Internet access and a Netflix ready device.
Terms.billingContent: The membership fee for the Netflix service and any other charges you may incur will be charged to your Payment Method.
Terms.serviceContent: You must be at least 18 years of age to become a member. Minors may only use the service under the supervision of an adult.
Terms.passwordsContent: The member who created the Netflix account is responsible for any activity that occurs through the account.

Privacy.title: Privacy Statement
Privacy.intro: At Netflix, we respect your privacy. Here is a simple breakdown.
Privacy.dataProtectionDesc: We encrypt your personal data to keep it safe.
Privacy.noSellingDesc: We never sell your personal information to third parties.
Privacy.controlDesc: You can download or delete your data at any time from settings.
Privacy.howWeUseDesc: We use information to provide, analyze, administer, enhance and personalize our services and marketing efforts, to process your registration, your orders and your payments.
Privacy.cookiesDesc: We and our Service Providers use cookies and other technologies (such as web beacons), as well as advertising identifiers, for various reasons.
Privacy.note: Note: By using our service, you agree to the collection of data as described in this policy.
